records.text: Nisi said Bagley's body camera had run for only 27 minutes even though those cameras were supposed to last around 10 hours.
records.speaker: Nisi (independent-media creator; full name unverified)

appearances.snippet: He says the battery died, but the camera had only been running for 27 minutes, and these body cameras are supposed to last around 10 hours.

verification.notes: The hearing record confirms that Bagley's only body-camera recording lasted 27 minutes and 35 seconds. Nisi also said such cameras were supposed to last around 10 hours, and some Axon models are marketed for a full shift, but the public record reviewed does not identify Bagley's camera model, its initial charge, configuration, or technical logs. The duration is verified; the specific 10-hour expectation for this device is not.
